items.name: MemoryConsumer
items.summary: A memory consumer is a named allocation traced by a particular [`MemoryReservation`] in a [`MemoryPool`]. All allocations are registered to a particular `MemoryConsumer`;

methods.name: can_spill
methods.summary: Returns true if this allocation can spill to disk

methods.name: clone_with_new_id
methods.summary: Returns a clone of this [`MemoryConsumer`] with a new unique id, which can be registered with a [`MemoryPool`], This new consumer is separate from the original.

methods.name: id
methods.summary: Return the unique id of this [`MemoryConsumer`]

methods.name: name
methods.summary: Returns the name associated with this allocation

methods.name: new
methods.summary: Create a new empty [`MemoryConsumer`] that can be grown using [`MemoryReservation`]

methods.name: register
methods.summary: Registers this [`MemoryConsumer`] with the provided [`MemoryPool`] returning a [`MemoryReservation`] that can be used to grow or shrink the memory reservation

methods.name: with_can_spill
methods.summary: Set whether this allocation can be spilled to disk

items.name: MemoryReservation
items.summary: A [`MemoryReservation`] tracks an individual reservation of a number of bytes of memory in a [`MemoryPool`] that is freed back to the pool on drop.

methods.name: consumer
methods.summary: Returns [MemoryConsumer] for this [MemoryReservation]

methods.name: free
methods.summary: Frees all bytes from this reservation back to the underlying pool, returning the number of bytes freed.

methods.name: grow
methods.summary: Increase the size of this reservation by `capacity` bytes

methods.name: new_empty
methods.summary: Returns a new empty [`MemoryReservation`] with the same [`MemoryConsumer`]

methods.name: resize
methods.summary: Sets the size of this reservation to `capacity`

methods.name: shrink
methods.summary: Frees `capacity` bytes from this reservation

methods.name: size
methods.summary: Returns the size of this reservation in bytes

methods.name: split
methods.summary: Splits off `capacity` bytes from this [`MemoryReservation`] into a new [`MemoryReservation`] with the same [`MemoryConsumer`].

methods.name: take
methods.summary: Splits off all the bytes from this [`MemoryReservation`] into a new [`MemoryReservation`] with the same [`MemoryConsumer`]

methods.name: try_grow
methods.summary: Try to increase the size of this reservation by `capacity` bytes, returning error if there is insufficient capacity left in the pool.

methods.name: try_resize
methods.summary: Try to set the size of this reservation to `capacity`

methods.name: try_shrink
methods.summary: Tries to free `capacity` bytes from this reservation if `capacity` does not exceed [`Self::size`]. Returns new reservation size, or error if shrinking capacity is more than allocated size.

items.name: MemoryPool
items.signature: trait MemoryPool: Any + Send + Sync + std::fmt::Debug + Display
items.summary: Tracks and potentially limits memory use across operators during execution.

methods.name: grow
methods.summary: Infallibly grow the provided `reservation` by `additional` bytes

methods.name: memory_limit
methods.summary: Return the memory limit of the pool

methods.name: name
methods.summary: Return pool name

methods.name: register
methods.summary: Registers a new [`MemoryConsumer`]

methods.name: reserved
methods.summary: Return the total amount of memory reserved

methods.name: shrink
methods.summary: Infallibly shrink the provided `reservation` by `shrink` bytes

methods.name: try_grow
methods.signature: fn try_grow(&self, reservation: &MemoryReservation, additional: usize) -> Result<()>
methods.summary: Attempt to grow the provided `reservation` by `additional` bytes

methods.name: unregister
methods.summary: Records the destruction of a [`MemoryReservation`] with [`MemoryConsumer`]
